<?php

foreach ([84, 9973, 15625, 1001, 123456, 48000, 999958, 999999] as $original) {
    $remaining = $original;
    $divisor = 2;
    $factors = [];
    while ($divisor * $divisor <= $remaining) {
        $exponent = 0;
        while ($remaining % $divisor === 0) {
            $remaining = intdiv($remaining, $divisor);
            $exponent++;
        }
        if ($exponent > 0) {
            $factors[] = $exponent === 1 ? (string) $divisor : $divisor . '^' . $exponent;
        }
        $divisor++;
    }
    if ($remaining > 1) {
        $factors[] = (string) $remaining;
    }
    printf("%d = %s\n", $original, implode(' * ', $factors));
}
